description: Use this when the user already has an email address and wants to know whether it is a real mailbox or will bounce: checking an address before sending, confirming an inbound lead, or cleaning addresses from a list or CRM. Returns valid, invalid, catch_all or unknown. Do not use to find an address the user does not have; use find_email. Costs 1 credit only when the mailbox is confirmed valid. Invalid, catch-all, unknown, and repeats are free and still return at 0 credits. A new valid mailbox fails at 0 balance with an insufficient_credits error. The credit is spent after a valid result. This does not modify the mailbox.

email.description: The email address to check, for example jane.doe@company.com

name: verify_email

credits_used.description: Credits this call spent. 0 for a free outcome.

repeat.description: True when this address was checked before; a repeat is free.

title: Verify one email
